system: MediaFind v2: MediaFind memory search (on-device ranking) + LLM memory cards and visual descriptions + LLM query rewrite + map-reduce answering

protocol.pipeline: MediaFind ranking (bge-m3 lexical fusion + BM25, whole-item bge-reranker-v2-m3 over the top-50) over the benchmark's own captions (Qwen3-VL-2B) and emails, 11,034 items, each photo/video extended with an LLM memory card; map-reduce answering over the top-25 items (map: relevance filter per batch of 10; reduce: time-sorted full text, reasoning then a single ANSWER line). List questions use a second ranking and map: the same memory search run with Qwen3-Embedding-4B (query prompt on the question side) over the original question and three LLM rewrites, its own bge-reranker-v2-m3 top-50 rerank, reciprocal-rank fused with the bge-m3 rerank list (weight 1.5); their relevance map reads all 25 items in one call, and their reduce input also includes the ten top-ranked items Number-type answers then pass through a deterministic string formatter (full month names instead of ISO dates, no seconds or timezone suffix, compact am/pm); no model call. Number questions use the list questions' Qwen3-Embedding-4B fused pool, and their relevance map (batches of ten) is done by Claude Haiku 5.5.
protocol.answer_model: openai/gpt-5.4-mini (reasoning effort minimal) via OpenRouter for the reduce step; deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash (reasoning off) via OpenRouter for the relevance map and for rewriting each question into a retrieval query (list questions also use rewrites by openai/gpt-5.4-mini and openai/gpt-5.4, and their relevance map reads all 25 items in one call); for number questions the relevance map is anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5 via OpenRouter
protocol.memory_model: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash via OpenRouter writes one memory card per photo/video from its caption, the person's emails (a trip/event timeline extracted from all emails) and same-day items; deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp via OpenRouter adds a dense visual description of each photo/video from the raw media
protocol.retriever: BAAI/bge-m3 + BM25 (MediaFind memory search, lexical fusion) + BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 whole-item rerank of the top-50, reciprocal-rank fused with the lexical ranking of the LLM-rewritten query; list questions: the same memory search run with Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B (its query prompt on the question side) over the original question and three LLM rewrites, its own bge-reranker-v2-m3 top-50 rerank, reciprocal-rank fused with the bge-m3 rerank list (weight 1.5); number questions use the same Qwen3-Embedding-4B fused pool as list questions
protocol.judge_model: openai/gpt-5-mini via OpenRouter, reasoning effort minimal
